question: Jagannath Temple constructed by a famous king of Ganga Dynasty Ananta Varman Chodaganga Deva dating back to 12th century is located at _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Jagannath Temple** is located in **Puri, Odisha**, and is one of the most significant Hindu temples dedicated to Lord Jagannath (a form of Lord Vishnu).
 
• It was constructed by **Ananta Varman Chodaganga Deva**, a famous king of the **Eastern Ganga Dynasty**, in the **12th century**.
 
• This temple is a part of the **Char Dham pilgrimage**, which also includes Badrinath, Dwarka, and Rameswaram, making it one of the holiest sites for Hindus.
 
• The temple is renowned for its annual Rath Yatra (Chariot Festival)</stro
